topic: How can satellite link budgets be optimized for high throughput and low latency in global aeronautical coverage?
response: Optimize satellite link budgets by considering power constraints, antenna gains, and link margins. Use high-gain antennas and amplify signal power to increase throughput. Implement adaptive modulation and coding to maintain low latency. Ensure link budgets meet standards like ITU-R P.618 for reliable transmission.
reference_context: Satellite link conditions vary, with high fixed latency and capacity constraints. Link budgets must consider power, antenna gains, and margins for reliable transmission, as noted in qos-provisioning and architectures-and-key-technical-challenges texts.
